entries.reason: SCAD compiler output and native LDraw expansion prepare canonical mesh/material/scene candidates; only the existing asset store publishes them.
protocol: eve asset import --from scad|ldraw prepares .eva; existing asset cook produces .evpack
entries.thread_affinity: Pure parsing/encoding is worker-safe and reentrant; external OpenSCAD process is desktop authoring only. GPU consumption uses the existing graphics-thread adapter.
cost_notes: Offline builder-style requests expand/copy geometry once per import; no runtime per-frame compilation or string lookup.

trim.absent_profile: L4 observable: OpenSCAD executable absent returns a checked failure, covered by structuredModelsScadCompilerAbsent; mobile/browser compiler adapter returns Unsupported. Cooked consumers do not invoke the compiler. No new independently trimmable module is claimed.
